subject: Change errno from EEXIST to EALREADY in serverFork if child process exists (#1258)
reason: The change only swaps errno from EEXIST to EALREADY in the serverFork branch that refuses a mutually-exclusive fork while a child is active. All in-tree command paths (BGSAVE, BGREWRITEAOF, replica full-sync) check hasActiveChildProcess() and bail out before calling serverFork, and the server is single-threaded, so that branch is unreachable from any command; none of their replies format the errno. The only live caller is ValkeyModule_Fork, where the effect is a changed log string and an errno value visible to module code, testable only by loading a test module that forks while another child r
